data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, included positive prior year development of GBP 3.3m (2021: GBP 39.7m) on the net claims reserves that existed at the end of the prior financial year.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2017 Year of Account RITC delay due to Co/Action Specialty Group reinsurance balances
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2017 YOA has not been able to close at 72 months by way of RITC due to continuing uncertainty regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group, affecting closure and reinsurance recoverables.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves opened at GBP 221.886m. Analysis of the syndicate's gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse (strengthening) prior-year development of approximately GBP 9.08m (c.4.09% of opening gross claims reserves). Management attributes movements to adverse development on prior years driven by reinsurance arrangements (notably the S5678 RITC and Hiscox ADC and related Gibson Re WQS impacts), claims inflation and deterioration in casualty business; RITC/reinsurance balance uncertainty (notably affecting the 2017 YOA) also complicated reserve movements.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2017YOA of Syndicate 1110 has not been able to close at 72 months, by way of RITC, as a result of continuing uncertainty regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group, who are the major reinsurer of the liabilities of this year of account.

The increase in net claims incurred has largely been driven by the S5678 RITC and Hiscox ADC (after the related Gibson Re WQS impact), along with the impact of claims inflation and deterioration of casualty business.
positive prior year development of GBP 3.3m (2021: GBP 39.7m) on the net claims reserves that existed at the end of the prior financial year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (notes) because no gross movement note was provided. The report also states a net prior-year movement (GBP 3.3m favourable) - that net figure is after reinsurance and differs from the gross triangle-based calculation (+GBP 9.082m adverse). The syndicate experienced RITC and funds-withheld arrangements (S5678 RITC, Hiscox ADC, Gibson Re WQS) which can distort development patterns and reinsurance recoverables; 2021 year is not presented (syndicate did not participate) which affects the usual 'exclude two most recent years' rule (only 2022 excluded here). Figures sourced from tables printed in GBP 000; triangle-derived PYD rounded to three decimals (millions).
